trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies on the same PlayStation profile. Check the PS5 trophy list for any missing award before marking the platinum here.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing by following the opening story objectives until the mission ends. It unlocks through normal story progression and needs no extra challenge.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Follow the main mission markers through the end of Chapter 1. Use the chapter's meditation spot before advancing and keep your opening manual save in a separate slot.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the main missions in Chapter 2 and play through the chapter transition. Keep your chapter-opening save until you've checked any optional objectives you meant to finish.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by following the main story chain to its end. The award is tied to chapter completion, so you can leave other free-roam objectives for later where available.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Clear the main story missions in Chapter 4 until the chapter ends. Keep a separate save before heading into the endgame so you can recover earlier progress if needed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Follow the main story through the final mission and play until it registers as complete. The published requirement names no ending or choice, so keep a pre-finale save as a precaution.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run when it appears in the main story and finish all its objectives. No separate score, optional action or fail condition is specified for this trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow the main story to The Cartel Heist and complete the mission through its final objective. The published requirement is mission completion, so there is no stated loot target to plan around.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: When Child's Play becomes available in the story, start it from its mission marker and finish the objectives. The trophy description lists no alternate route or bonus requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Continue the main story until Headliners opens, then complete it and wait for the mission to register as finished. No optional objective is listed for the award.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Start VCIA Takedown when the story offers it and follow the mission through completion. The separate airport departure trophy has an unconfirmed trigger and should be tracked separately.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory during the main story. The list gives no special route or score requirement, so finish the mission normally and check the PS5 trophy list before advancing.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game's completion tracker to identify which story and side objectives still count toward 100%. Tackle one incomplete category at a time and verify its total before moving on. The trophy checklist on this site is separate from the game's completion percentage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete stunts around Leonida and verify each success registers toward the 250 target. Group nearby opportunities into routes and record completed ones so you can pick up where you left off. Don't assume repeats count unless the counter moves.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types as its marker becomes available in Leonida. Keep a list by activity type and play until the attempt registers before counting it. Use leftover types to guide your mop-up.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting ranges and earn gold in all 42 challenges. Check the medal list before leaving each range, then revisit any challenge with a lower medal. Repeat difficult drills on their own so you can learn the target sequence.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Enter a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations and finish first. Record the venue after each win because repeating a favorite course will not cover a missing location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races as they open around Leonida. Track the event name and verify the win on the results screen before moving on. Replaying a race you've already won does not meet the distinct-race requirement.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's activity prompt to start his fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. Check the result before leaving and return to Cal for another attempt if offered. The exact unlock timing and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find a playable arcade cabinet and choose a game you can take through its ending. Stay until the game registers completion, since opening the cabinet or starting a run doesn't meet the listed requirement.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's side missions as his markers become available and finish the last job in his chain. Track Andy separately while working on the eight stranger strands. The exact opening location and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's side missions whenever his next marker is available, through the final job. Keep a record of the strand for your side-mission cleanup. The precise trigger for the first mission and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Pick up Billy's side mission when it appears and follow through on each subsequent job until the strand ends. Check the mission log if his next marker disappears. No specific unlock timing or cutoff is confirmed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission chains across Leonida. Track the contact and the last job you completed, since an introductory encounter alone does not finish a strand. Check for follow-up missions before writing off a missing strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's jobs as they appear and follow the chain to his final mission. Check whether his strand is finished before counting it toward your stranger total. The exact starting trigger and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Take Tyrone's side missions through their finale, returning when a follow-up becomes available. Verify that the final job registered as complete before moving on. His earliest availability and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, counting only spots where you complete the interaction. One spot is tied to Chapter 1, so use it before advancing and verify it registered. There is no mission replay, so retain a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 in case you need to go back.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret's hunting activity and accept the hunt for his unique animal when offered. Use the objective to identify the required animal and stay until the hunt registers as complete. The precise location and any cutoff are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets by checking which cards are missing from each set. Prioritize sets where you already have several cards and record pickups as you explore so you can target the gaps later.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 distinct locations across Leonida. Record each location after the interaction registers, and group nearby locations into routes to cut down on backtracking. Check for missing stops if your count stalls.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Work through the available challenge objectives and finish 50 of them. Choose challenges you can combine with races, exploration or other trophy work, and check the completion count as you go.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: In free roam with your partner present, raise the wanted level to four stars and escape until the search ends. Plan a route with places to break line of sight and keep your partner with you through the escape. Save first so you can retry a failed attempt.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: In free roam with your partner, pick three shops close enough to reach without dropping your wanted level. Complete the robberies in one continuous chase and escape afterward. Make a manual save before the first shop so you can retry the whole sequence if the heat drops early.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicle types while exploring Leonida, including vehicles outside your usual routes. Check what the game records as a new discovery before counting a vehicle and move on once its entry has registered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Look for an encounter with at least five enemies and wait until you can reach them in one Combat Focus activation. Take down all five before that single use expires. Keep a save before a suitable encounter since story missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The published hint points to Vice City International Airport. The qualifying departure, vehicle and whether this is tied to a mission are unconfirmed. Keep an airport-area save if you want to test the trigger.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The hint refers to Rhino tanks, but the qualifying action and location are unconfirmed. Keep a separate save if you encounter a Rhino so you can revisit the opportunity once the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Look for an eligible jewelry store robbery and keep detection clear from entry through the moment the robbery registers. Save before attempting it so you can retry if spotted. The specific store and detection rules are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five bank vault robberies and escape each one. Count an attempt only after the escape registers, and track which vaults you've cleared in case repeated locations don't count. Keep a save before an attempt if the escape is giving you trouble.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: When an armored truck robbery becomes available, complete the robbery and leave the scene until the escape registers. Check the trophy before counting the job and keep a manual save if you need to retry.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas across Leonida and confirm each discovery as you cross into it. Compare the map with your discovered-area list, then sweep the remaining gaps region by region.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one eligible illegal operation for each of the nine gangs. Record the gang after each completed robbery, since clearing several operations for one gang won't cover a missing faction.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Explore Ocean Beach for a venue that offers a cocktail interaction with a view. The exact venue and any time-of-day or seating requirements are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The hint points to driving a vehicle out of a showroom through a breakable exit. The qualifying showroom, vehicle and any associated mission are unconfirmed. Keep a save before experimenting with a showroom encounter.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Look for the bowling activity at Kolt & Associates and play through to the result. The published hint names the venue, but any score requirement or specific follow-through trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description hints at something involving the partnership, but its unlock method, location and timing are unconfirmed. Keep separate chapter saves so you can revisit earlier opportunities if the trigger turns out to be story-specific.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The starter list reports a PSN counter to 500, but which choices increment it is unconfirmed. Check the counter after decision prompts before committing to a repeated activity. No location or cutoff has been established.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The hint suggests a second attempt, but the relevant event and reset conditions are unconfirmed. Keep a save before unusual encounters if you want the option of testing them again.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The published hint does not identify the event, its location or the conditions for seeing it. Keep a separate save if you encounter an unusual event and want to check whether it can be repeated later.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description calls for a melee drive-by that knocks a target down. Try it once you have a vehicle that supports the move, then check for the trophy. The exact target count and whether a specific vehicle is required are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Take Marked Bills to contacts who offer laundering and keep using them until the earned total reaches $250,000. Check the recorded proceeds after each transaction so you know how far you have left.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida and check that purchases advance the relevant total. Fold necessary supplies or gear into the target as you play, then use remaining cash to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties as they become available. Track them by location and budget for the remaining garages before making big discretionary purchases.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles and confirm that each one shows as registered. Check the app's current requirements before sourcing another vehicle, then use the registration count to track what's left.
